item_name: Rothco Deluxe Police Low Profile Cap

This cap features the word "POLICE" prominently displayed in large, raised, embroidered letters on the front panel, showcasing impeccable detailing. Constructed from 100% brushed cotton twill, the police baseball cap is designed to be durable and long-lasting, making it a reliable choice for rugged use. The cap also features a sun-shielding sandwich brim with the word "POLICE" written twice for added style and functionality.
